issue_context.title: There is a memory leak defect at line 1234 in the file /godot/servers/audio_server.cpp.
issue_context.body:
### Tested versions

4.4-stable

### System information

Ubuntu 20.04

### Issue description

At line 1225 in the file /godot/servers/audio_server.cpp, a pointer variable named playback_node is defined and allocated a new dynamic memory region using the new operator. When the if condition at line 1232 evaluates to true, the function neither utilizes the dynamic memory region pointed to by playback_node as done at line 1259 nor frees the dynamic memory region pointed to by new_bus_details (another dynamically allocated memory block) before returning, as done at line 1233. This results in a memory leak defect, as illustrated below.
https://github.com/LuMingYinDetect/godot_defects/blob/main/godot_2.png
